gates_without_proof.why: gaps.md G8 — 'is it passing' and 'can it fail' are different questions, and mac-build.yml answered the first correctly for three months while being incapable of the second

mypy_errors.note: Set from CI, not from a dev machine: pyproject pins mypy>=1.13 (a floor), so the count moves with whatever a fresh install resolves. 238 locally / 239 in CI on 3 Sep 2026 for identical source.
mypy_errors.why: gaps.md G3 — soft since it was added, which is how it reached 238

pytest_skip_sites.basis: skipif + bare skip + runtime pytest.skip() across tests/
pytest_skip_sites.note: 22 -> 23 on 3 Sep 2026, deliberately. The live-LLM AutoCode harness used to ERROR when the Anthropic account ran out of credit, so every local close-out reported 3 errors that were not regressions - noise that trains people to ignore a red summary line, which is the same defect as a skip reading as a pass, only louder. It now skips with a message that leads 'SKIPPED, NOT PASSED', per G2's 'make the skip loud'. This brings it into line with the other two slow files, which already guarded (test_pii_audit skipif, test_no_fake_success_acceptance runtime skip) - it is the third of three, not new debt. A genuine BAD_REQUEST/UNKNOWN still fails.
pytest_skip_sites.why: a skip reads as a pass in every summary line — gaps.md G2

pytest_slow_marked.why: excluded from CI by -m 'not slow', so each one is CI coverage given up
